scope: Any future diagnostic-only strategy evaluation using HISTORICAL_UNIVERSE_RECONSTRUCTION_2024H1.

execution.signal_observation: A daily signal may use only candles closed at the decision-day UTC close.
execution.cost_application: Deduct fee and adverse slippage on every entry, rebalance, and exit fill; no netting across symbols unless the execution model proves it.

funding.source: Binance data.binance.vision USD-M monthly fundingRate archive with publisher CHECKSUM
funding.accounting: At every funding event within [entry, exit), subtract signed position weight times funding rate; positive rates are paid by longs and received by shorts.

prohibited: same-close execution after observing that close
fee-only result labelled as net return
